summary: ArcelorMittal (Luxembourg) filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, attaching a press release that announces the publication of its second-quarter 2026 sell-side analyst consensus figures. The consensus, compiled by Visible Alpha from approximately 13 brokers, includes estimated EBITDA of $2,037 million, net income of $802 million, and EPS of $1.06. The filing is a routine disclosure of third-party analyst estimates and does not involve any corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special situation. It serves only to inform the market of aggregated analyst expectations for the quarter.
